ko.title: 12월 11일까지 재정 지원: 셧다운 다툼을 중간선거 이후로 미룬 상원 합의의 내막

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## 막판 타결로 10월 1일 셧다운 위기 면해

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: 연방 정부의 회계연도가 9월 30일에 종료될 예정인 가운데, 양당 상원 지도부는 **12월 11일**까지 연방 기관의 예산을 유지하는 임시지출안(CR)에 대해 초당적 합의를 이루었습니다.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: 이 합의안은 여야 의원들의 지지를 받으며 상원을 통과하여, 새 회계연도가 시작되는 시점에 비필수 정부 운영이 중단될 뻔했던 자금 지원 공백 위기를 아슬아슬하게 피했습니다.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: 임시지출안은 의원들이 제때 전체 예산안 심사 과정을 마치지 못할 때 의회가 사용하는, 불완전하지만 상례적인 수단입니다.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: 매년 12개의 개별 지출 법안을 따로 통과시키는 대신, CR은 일정 기간 동안 기존 예산 수준을 연장하여 정부 서비스, 연방 근로자의 봉급, 수백만 미국인이 의지하는 혜택 지급을 중단하지 않고 협상가들이 장기 예산의 세부 사항을 조율할 시간을 더 벌어줍니다.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## 12월 11일이 중요한 이유

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: 12월 마감 시한을 선택한 것은 그 시한이 달성하는 성과만큼이나 피하게 해주는 상황 때문에 주목할 만합니다.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: 다음 예산 시한을 11월 선거일 이후로 설정함으로써, 이번 합의는 중간선거 캠페인의 막바지 동안 정부 예산안이 실질적인 쟁점이 되지 않도록 효율적으로 제거했습니다.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: 양당 의원들은 역사적으로 셧다운의 정치적 여파를 예측하기 어렵고 양당 현역 의원 모두에게 영향을 미치는 경향이 있기 때문에, 선거와 맞물리는 일촉즉발의 셧다운 다툼을 경계해 왔습니다.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: 그렇긴 하지만, 마감 시한을 12월로 미루는 것이 최근 몇 년 동안 전년도 전체 예산안 통과를 어렵게 만든 근본적인 의견 불일치를 해결해 주지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: 재량 지출의 규모, 특정 기관의 예산 우선순위, 지출 법안에 첨부된 정책 조항에 대한 논쟁은 여전히 해결되지 않은 상태로 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: 양당 의회 지도자들은 이번 연장을 해결책이라기보다는 "시간을 버는" 방법으로 설명했으므로, 중간선거 이후 몇 주 동안 잠재적으로 더 큰 위험이 수반되는 유사한 협상이 다시 수면 위로 오를 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## 임시지출안이 하는 일과 하지 않는 일

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: 일반 미국인들에게 CR은 일반적으로 정부 운영이 이전과 다름없이 계속된다는 것을 의미합니다. 연방 공무원은 계속 일하고, 정부 기관은 계속 운영되며, 사회 보장, 보훈 혜택, 우편 배달과 같은 서비스는 차질 없이 계속됩니다.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: 그러나 CR은 일반적으로 지출을 전년도 수준으로 동결하고 신규 프로그램이나 사업을 시작하는 기관의 능력을 제한할 수 있으므로, 의원들과 정부 기관 관계자들은 정기 예산 편성의 대체재라기보다는 불완전한 임시방편으로 보는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: 시장과 연방 계약업체들 역시 이러한 마감 시한을 주시하는 경향이 있는데, 짧은 셧다운조차도 대금 지급을 지연시키고, 계약 수주를 늦추며, 연방 예산 주기에 의존하는 기업들에 불확실성을 조성할 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 과제

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: 당장의 셧다운 위기가 연기됨에 따라 이제 관심은 중간선거 이후에 일어날 일로 옮겨가고 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 선거 이후 새 의원이 임기를 시작하기 전까지의 기간인 의회의 "레임덕" 회기가 역사적으로 대규모 지출 패키지를 포함하여 마무리되지 않은 주요 입법 과제를 처리하는 데 활용되어 왔다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: 이번 12월 마감 시한이 정식 예산 법안 타결로 이어질지, 또 다른 단기 연장으로 이어질지, 아니면 대치가 재발할지는 중간선거 결과와 그에 따른 의회의 권력 균형 이동에 따라 달라질 것입니다.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 이번 초당적 합의가 워싱턴의 반복되는 예산 전쟁에서 일시적인 휴전을 의미하며, 연말에 의원들이 더 어려운 문제를 해결할 수 있도록 남겨둔 채 정부를 계속 운영할 수 있게 해줍니다.

zh.title: 资金维持至12月11日：深入了解将政府停摆危机推迟至中期选举后的参议院协议

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## 最后时刻达成的协议避免了10月1日的政府停摆

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: 随着联邦政府的财政年度定于9月30日结束，参议院两党领袖达成了一项关于持续决议案（CR）的两党协议，使联邦机构的资金能够维持至 **12月11日**。

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: 该协议在两党议员的支持下在参议院获得通过，险些避免了资金中断，否则在新财年开始之际，非必要的政府运作将被迫停摆。

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: 当国会议员无法按时完成完整的拨款程序时，持续决议案是国会使用的一种常规但并不完美的工具。

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: 持续决议案（CR）并非逐一通过全部十二项年度支出法案，而是将当前的资金水平延长一段时间，从而给谈判人员更多时间来敲定长期预算的细节，同时不会中断政府服务、联邦雇员的薪水或数百万美国人所依赖的福利金支付。

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么12月11日很重要

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: 选择12月作为截止日期之所以引人注目，不仅在于它达成了什么，还在于它避免了什么。

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: 通过将下一个资金悬崖设定在11月选举日之后，该协议有效地消除了政府资金问题在中期选举竞选最后阶段成为活跃的冲突点。

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: 两党议员历来都对与选举同时发生的高风险停摆斗争持谨慎态度，因为停摆带来的政治后果往往难以预测，且往往会影响两党的现任议员。

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: 话虽如此，将截止日期推迟到12月并不能解决近年来导致全年拨款法案难以通过的根本分歧。

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: 关于可自由支配支出规模、特定机构的资金优先事项以及附加在支出法案上的政策条款的争议仍然悬而未决。

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: 国会两党领袖都将此次延期描述为一种“争取时间”的方式，而非解决方案，这意味着在中期选举后的几周内，类似的谈判（可能风险更高）很可能会再次出现。

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## 持续决议案的作用与局限

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: 对于普通美国人来说，持续决议案（CR）通常意味着政府运作基本照常进行：联邦雇员继续工作，机构继续运行，社会保障、退伍军人福利和邮件投递等服务继续不间断地提供。

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: 然而，持续决议案通常会将支出冻结在上一年的水平，并可能限制机构启动新项目或倡议的能力，这就是为什么议员和机构官员通常将其视为一种不完美的权宜之计，而不是常规预算编制的替代品。

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: 市场和联邦承包商也倾向于密切关注这些截止日期，因为即使是短暂的停摆也可能扰乱付款、推迟合同授予，并为依赖联邦资金周期的企业带来不确定性。

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## 前路如何

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: 随着迫在眉睫的停摆威胁被推迟，人们的注意力现在转向了中期选举之后会发生什么。

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: 分析人士指出，国会的“跛脚鸭”会议（即选举后但新当选议员宣誓就职前的时期）历来被用于处理重大的、未完成的立法事务，包括大型支出方案。

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: 这个12月的截止日期是会产生一套完整的拨款法案、另一次短期延期，还是会导致新的僵局，很可能取决于中期选举的结果以及由此导致的国会权力平衡的变化。

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: 目前，这项两党协议代表了华盛顿反复出现的预算斗争中的暂时休战——它在保持政府开放的同时，将更棘手的问题留给议员们在今年晚些时候去解决。

hi.title: 11 दिसंबर तक फंडिंग: सीनेट समझौते के अंदर जिसने शटडाउन की लड़ाई को मध्यावधि चुनावों के बाद तक टाल दिया

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## अंतिम समय के समझौते ने 1 अक्टूबर के शटडाउन को टाला

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: संघीय सरकार का वित्तीय वर्ष 30 सितंबर को समाप्त होने वाला था, ऐसे में दोनों दलों के सीनेट नेताओं ने एक निरंतर संकल्प (CR) पर द्विदलीय सहमति बनाई, जो संघीय एजेंसियों को **11 दिसंबर** तक फंड देता है।

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: यह समझौता दोनों पक्षों के सदस्यों के समर्थन से सदन से पारित हो गया, जिससे फंडिंग में उस कमी को टाल दिया गया जो नए वित्तीय वर्ष की शुरुआत में ही गैर-जरूरी सरकारी कार्यों को बंद करने के लिए मजबूर कर सकती थी।

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: निरंतर संकल्प (Continuing resolutions) एक नियमित, हालांकि अपूर्ण, उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग कांग्रेस तब करती है जब कानून निर्माता समय पर पूर्ण विनियोग प्रक्रिया को पूरा नहीं कर पाते हैं।

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: सभी बारह वार्षिक व्यय बिलों को व्यक्तिगत रूप से पारित करने के बजाय, एक CR एक निर्धारित अवधि के लिए वर्तमान फंडिंग स्तरों का विस्तार करता है, जिससे वार्ताकारों को सरकारी सेवाओं, संघीय कर्मचारियों के वेतन, या उन लाभ भुगतानों को बाधित किए बिना दीर्घकालिक बजट के विवरण पर काम करने के लिए अधिक समय मिलता है, जिन पर लाखों अमेरिकी निर्भर हैं।

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## 11 दिसंबर क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: दिसंबर की समय सीमा का चुनाव इसलिए उल्लेखनीय है क्योंकि यह उन चीजों से बचता है जिन्हें यह पूरा करता है।

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: अगली फंडिंग समय सीमा को नवंबर में चुनाव के बाद निर्धारित करके, यह समझौता प्रभावी रूप से मध्यावधि चुनाव अभियान के अंतिम चरण के दौरान सरकारी फंडिंग को एक सक्रिय विवाद का मुद्दा बनने से हटा देता है।

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्षों के कानून निर्माता ऐतिहासिक रूप से चुनावों के साथ होने वाली उच्च-दांव वाली शटडाउन लड़ाइयों से सावधान रहे हैं, क्योंकि शटडाउन का राजनीतिक परिणाम अप्रत्याशित हो सकता है और यह दोनों दलों के मौजूदा पदाधिकारियों को प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: इसके बावजूद, समय सीमा को दिसंबर तक बढ़ाने से वे अंतर्निहित असहमति हल नहीं होती हैं जिन्होंने हाल के वर्षों में पूर्ण-वर्ष के विनियोगों को पारित करना कठिन बना दिया है।

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: विवेकाधीन खर्च के आकार, विशिष्ट एजेंसियों के लिए फंडिंग प्राथमिकताएं, और व्यय बिलों से जुड़ी नीतिगत प्रावधानों पर विवाद अनसुलझे हैं।

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्षों के कांग्रेसी नेताओं ने इस विस्तार को समाधान के बजाय "समय खरीदने" के एक तरीके के रूप में वर्णित किया है, जिसका अर्थ है कि मध्यावधि चुनावों के बाद के हफ्तों में एक समान बातचीत — संभावित रूप से उच्च दांव के साथ — फिर से उभरने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## निरंतर संकल्प क्या करता है और क्या नहीं करता है

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: आम अमेरिकियों के लिए, एक CR का सामान्य अर्थ यह है कि सरकारी कामकाज पहले की तरह जारी रहता है: संघीय कर्मचारी काम करना जारी रखते हैं, एजेंसियां चलती रहती हैं, और सामाजिक सुरक्षा, दिग्गजों के लाभ और डाक वितरण जैसी सेवाएं बिना किसी रुकावट के जारी रहती हैं।

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: हालांकि, CR आमतौर पर पिछले वर्ष के स्तरों पर खर्च को स्थिर कर देते हैं और एजेंसियों की नई कार्यक्रमों या पहलों को शुरू करने की क्षमता को सीमित कर सकते हैं, यही कारण है कि कानून निर्माता और एजेंसी अधिकारी अक्सर उन्हें नियमित बजट के विकल्प के बजाय एक अपूर्ण अस्थायी उपाय के रूप में देखते हैं।

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: बाजार और संघीय ठेकेदार भी इन समय सीमाओं पर कड़ी नजर रखते हैं, क्योंकि छोटे शटडाउन भी भुगतान को बाधित कर सकते हैं, अनुबंध पुरस्कारों में देरी कर सकते हैं, और उन व्यवसायों के लिए अनिश्चितता पैदा कर सकते हैं जो संघीय फंडिंग चक्रों पर निर्भर हैं।

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## आगे की राह

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: तत्काल शटडाउन के खतरे को टालने के साथ, अब ध्यान इस बात पर केंद्रित हो गया है कि मध्यावधि चुनावों के बाद क्या होगा।

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि कांग्रेस के "लेम डक" सत्र — चुनाव के बाद लेकिन नए निर्वाचित सदस्यों के शपथ लेने से पहले की अवधि — का उपयोग ऐतिहासिक रूप से बड़े, अधूरे विधायी कार्यों, जिसमें बड़े व्यय पैकेज शामिल हैं, से निपटने के लिए किया गया है।

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: क्या यह दिसंबर की समय सीमा विनियोग बिलों के पूर्ण सेट, एक और अल्पकालिक विस्तार, या एक नए गतिरोध में परिणत होगी, यह संभवतः मध्यावधि चुनावों के परिणाम और इसके परिणामस्वरूप कांग्रेस में शक्ति संतुलन कैसे बदलता है, इस पर निर्भर करेगा।

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, द्विदलीय समझौता वाशिंगटन की आवर्ती बजट लड़ाइयों में एक अस्थायी युद्धविराम का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है — जो सरकार को खुला रखता है जबकि कठिन सवालों को कानून निर्माताओं के लिए इस साल के अंत में सुलझाने के लिए छोड़ देता है।

es.title: Financiado hasta el 11 de diciembre: Dentro del acuerdo del Senado que pospuso una lucha por el cierre del gobierno más allá de las elecciones de mitad de mandato

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## Un acuerdo de última hora evita un cierre el 1 de octubre

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: Con el año fiscal del gobierno federal programado para finalizar el 30 de septiembre, los líderes del Senado de ambos partidos llegaron a un acuerdo bipartidista sobre una resolución continua (CR, por sus siglas en inglés) que mantiene a las agencias federales financiadas hasta el **11 de diciembre**.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: El acuerdo fue aprobado por la cámara con el apoyo de miembros de ambos lados del pasillo, evitando por poco una interrupción en la financiación que habría forzado el cierre de operaciones gubernamentales no esenciales justo cuando comenzaba el nuevo año fiscal.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: Las resoluciones continuas son una herramienta rutinaria, aunque imperfecta, que el Congreso utiliza cuando los legisladores no pueden terminar el proceso completo de asignaciones a tiempo.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: En lugar de aprobar los doce proyectos de ley de gastos anuales individualmente, una CR extiende los niveles de financiación actuales por un período determinado, dando a los negociadores más tiempo para resolver los detalles de un presupuesto a más largo plazo sin interrumpir los servicios gubernamentales, los cheques de pago de los trabajadores federales o los pagos de beneficios de los que dependen millones de estadounidenses.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué es importante el 11 de diciembre

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: La elección de una fecha límite en diciembre es notable tanto por lo que evita como por lo que logra.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: Al establecer el próximo límite de financiación para después del día de las elecciones en noviembre, el acuerdo elimina efectivamente la financiación del gobierno como un punto de conflicto activo durante el tramo final de la temporada de campaña de mitad de mandato.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: Los legisladores de ambos lados han sido históricamente cautelosos con las luchas de alto riesgo por el cierre del gobierno que coinciden con las elecciones, ya que las consecuencias políticas de un cierre pueden ser impredecibles y tienden a afectar a los titulares de ambos partidos.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: Dicho esto, posponer la fecha límite hasta diciembre no resuelve los desacuerdos subyacentes que han dificultado la aprobación de las asignaciones de todo el año en los últimos años.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: Las disputas sobre el tamaño del gasto discrecional, las prioridades de financiación para agencias específicas y las disposiciones políticas adjuntas a los proyectos de ley de gastos siguen sin resolverse.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Los líderes del Congreso de ambos lados han descrito la extensión como una forma de "ganar tiempo" en lugar de una resolución, lo que significa que es probable que una negociación similar, potencialmente con mayores riesgos, resurja en las semanas posteriores a las elecciones de mitad de mandato.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## Qué hace y qué no hace una resolución continua

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: Para los estadounidenses comunes, una CR generalmente significa que las operaciones gubernamentales continúan en gran medida como antes: los empleados federales siguen trabajando, las agencias siguen funcionando y servicios como la Seguridad Social, los beneficios para veteranos y la entrega de correo continúan sin interrupciones.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, las CR suelen congelar el gasto a los niveles del año anterior y pueden limitar la capacidad de las agencias para iniciar nuevos programas o iniciativas, razón por la cual los legisladores y funcionarios de las agencias a menudo los ven como un parche imperfecto en lugar de un sustituto del presupuesto regular.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: Los mercados y los contratistas federales también tienden a observar de cerca estos plazos, ya que incluso los cierres breves pueden interrumpir los pagos, retrasar la adjudicación de contratos y crear incertidumbre para las empresas que dependen de los ciclos de financiación federal.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## El camino por delante

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: Con la amenaza inmediata de cierre pospuesta, la atención ahora se desplaza a lo que sucederá después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: Los analistas señalan que las sesiones de "pato cojo" (lame duck) del Congreso, el período posterior a una elección pero antes de que los miembros recién elegidos presten juramento, se han utilizado históricamente para abordar asuntos legislativos importantes e inacabados, incluidos grandes paquetes de gastos.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: Si esta fecha límite de diciembre resulta en un conjunto completo de proyectos de ley de asignaciones, otra extensión a corto plazo o un nuevo enfrentamiento dependerá probablemente del resultado de las elecciones de mitad de mandato y de cómo cambie el equilibrio de poder en el Congreso como resultado.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: Por ahora, el acuerdo bipartidista representa una tregua temporal en las recurrentes batallas presupuestarias de Washington, una que mantiene al gobierno abierto mientras deja las preguntas más difíciles para que los legisladores las resuelvan más adelante este año.

ar.title: التمويل حتى 11 ديسمبر: نظرة داخل صفقة مجلس الشيوخ التي أجلت معركة الإغلاق إلى ما بعد انتخابات التجديد النصفي

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## صفقة اللحظة الأخيرة تجنب إغلاقاً في 1 أكتوبر

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: مع اقتراب السنة المالية للحكومة الفيدرالية من نهايتها في 30 سبتمبر، توصل زعماء مجلس الشيوخ من كلا الحزبين إلى اتفاق ثنائي الحزب بشأن قرار مستمر (CR) يحافظ على تمويل الوكالات الفيدرالية حتى **11 ديسمبر**.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: تم إقرار الصفقة في المجلس بدعم من أعضاء من كلا الجانبين، مما أدى إلى تجنب انقطاع التمويل بفارق ضئيل والذي كان سيجبر على إغلاق العمليات الحكومية غير الأساسية تماماً مع بدء السنة المالية الجديدة.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: تعتبر القرارات المستمرة أداة روتينية، وإن كانت غير مثالية، يستخدمها الكونغرس عندما لا يتمكن المشرعون من إنهاء عملية الاعتمادات الكاملة في الوقت المحدد.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: بدلاً من إقرار جميع فواتير الإنفاق السنوية الاثنتي عشرة بشكل فردي، يمدد القرار المستمر مستويات التمويل الحالية لفترة محددة، مما يمنح المفاوضين وقتاً أطول لتسوية تفاصيل ميزانية أطول أمدى دون مقاطعة الخدمات الحكومية، أو رواتب العمال الفيدراليين، أو مدفوعات المزايا التي يعتمد عليها ملايين الأمريكيين.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم 11 ديسمبر

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: اختيار موعد نهائي في ديسمبر جدير باللاحظة لما يتجنبه بقدر ما يحققه.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: من خلال تحديد جرف التمويل التالي لما بعد يوم الانتخابات في نوفمبر، يزيل الاتفاق فعلياً تمويل الحكومة كقطاع ساخن نشط خلال الشوط الأخير من موسم حملة التجديد النصفي.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: كان المشرعون من الجانبين حذرين تاريخياً من معارك الإغلاق عالية المخاطر التي تتزامن مع الانتخابات، نظراً لأن التداعيات السياسية للإغلاق يمكن أن تكون غير متوقعة وتصيب عادةً شاغلي الوظائف من كلا الحزبين.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، فإن دفع الموعد النهائي إلى ديسمبر لا يحل الخلافات الكامنة التي جعلت تمرير الاعتمادات لمدة عام كامل أمراً صعباً في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: لا تزال الخلافات حول حجم الإنفاق التقديري، وأولويات التمويل لوكالات محددة، وبنود السياسة المرفقة بفواتير الإنفاق دون حل.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: وصف زعماء الكونغرس من الجانبين التمديد بأنه وسيلة لـ "كسب الوقت" وليس حلاً، مما يعني أن مفاوضات مماثلة - ربما بمخاطر أعلى - من المرجح أن تظهر مرة أخرى في الأسابيع التالية لانتخابات التجديد النصفي.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## ما يفعله القرار المستمر وما لا يفعله

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأمريكيين العاديين، يعني القرار المستمر عموماً أن العمليات الحكومية تستمر إلى حد كبير كما كانت من قبل: يستمر الموظفون الفيدراليون في العمل، وتستمر الوكالات في العمل، وتستمر خدمات مثل الضمان الاجتماعي، ومزايا المحاربين القدامى، وتسليم البريد دون انقطاع.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، عادة ما تجمد القرارات المستمرة الإنفاق عند مستويات العام السابق ويمكن أن تحد من قدرة الوكالات على بدء برامج أو مبادرات جديدة، ولهذا السبب غالباً ما يراها المشرعون ومسؤولو الوكالات كحل مؤقت غير مثالي بدلاً من بديل للميزانية العادية.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: تميل الأسواق والمقاولون الفيدراليون أيضاً إلى مراقبة هذه المواعيد النهائية عن كثب، نظراً لأن حتى عمليات الإغلاق القصيرة يمكن أن تعطل المدفوعات، وتؤخر عقود المناقصات، وتخلق حالة من عدم اليقين للشركات التي تعتمد على دورات التمويل الفيدرالي.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## الطريق إلى الأمام
