segments.tr: مع تأجيل تهديد الإغلاق الفوري، ينتقل الانتباه الآن إلى ما سيحدث بعد التجديد النصفي.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: يلاحظ المحللون أن جلسات "البطة العرجاء" للكونغرس - الفترة التي تلي الانتخابات ولكن قبل أداء الأعضاء المنتخبين حديثاً اليمين الدستورية - تم استخدامها تاريخياً لمعالجة الأعمال التشريعية الكبرى غير المكتملة، بما في ذلك حزم الإنفاق الكبيرة.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: ما إذا كان موعد ديسمبر النهائي سيؤدي إلى مجموعة كاملة من فواتير الاعتمادات، أو تمديد قصير الأجل آخر، أو مواجهة متجددة سيعتمد على الأرجح على نتائج انتخابات التجديد النصفي وكيف يتغير توازن القوى في الكونغرس نتيجة لذلك.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يمثل الاتفاق ثنائي الحزب هدنة مؤقتة في معارك الميزانية المتكررة في واشنطن - وهي هدنة تبقي الحكومة مفتوحة بينما تترك الأسئلة الأكثر صعوبة للمشرعين لحلها في وقت لاحق من هذا العام.

fr.title: Financé jusqu'au 11 décembre : Dans les coulisses de l'accord du Sénat qui a repoussé la lutte contre le shutdown au-delà des élections de mi-mandat

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## Un accord de dernière minute évite un shutdown le 1er octobre

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: Alors que l'exercice fiscal du gouvernement fédéral devait se terminer le 30 septembre, les chefs du Sénat des deux partis sont parvenus à un accord bipartisan sur une résolution continue (CR) qui maintient le financement des agences fédérales jusqu'au **11 décembre**.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: L'accord a été adopté par la chambre avec le soutien des membres des deux bords, évitant de justesse une interruption du financement qui aurait forcé la fermeture des opérations gouvernementales non essentielles juste au moment où le nouvel exercice fiscal commençait.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: Les résolutions continues sont un outil courant, bien qu'imparfait, que le Congrès utilise lorsque les législateurs ne peuvent pas terminer le processus complet des crédits à temps.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: Plutôt que de voter les douze projets de loi de finances annuels individuellement, une CR prolonge les niveaux de financement actuels pour une période déterminée, donnant aux négociateurs plus de temps pour régler les détails d'un budget à plus long terme sans interrompre les services gouvernementaux, les salaires des employés fédéraux ou les paiements de prestations dont dépendent des millions d'Américains.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le 11 décembre est important

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: Le choix d'une date limite en décembre est notable autant pour ce qu'il évite que pour ce qu'il accomplit.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: En fixant la prochaine falaise budgétaire après le jour des élections en novembre, l'accord supprime effectivement le financement du gouvernement en tant que point de friction actif pendant la dernière ligne droite de la campagne des élections de mi-mandat.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: Les législateurs des deux bords se sont historiquement méfiés des luttes à enjeux élevés autour du shutdown coïncidant avec les élections, car les retombées politiques d'un shutdown peuvent être imprévisibles et ont tendance à affecter les sortants des deux partis.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: Cela dit, repousser la date limite à décembre ne résout pas les désaccords sous-jacents qui ont rendu difficile l'adoption des crédits annuels complets ces dernières années.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: Les différends sur le montant des dépenses discrétionnaires, les priorités de financement pour des agences spécifiques et les dispositions politiques attachées aux projets de loi de finances restent non résolus.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Les chefs du Congrès des deux bords ont décrit cette prolongation comme un moyen d'« acheter du temps » plutôt que comme une résolution, ce qui signifie qu'une négociation similaire — potentiellement avec des enjeux plus élevés — est susceptible de refaire surface dans les semaines suivant les élections de mi-mandat.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'une résolution continue fait et ne fait pas

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: Pour les Américains ordinaires, une CR signifie généralement que les opérations gouvernementales se poursuivent en grande partie comme avant : les employés fédéraux continuent de travailler, les agences continuent de fonctionner et les services comme la sécurité sociale, les prestations aux anciens combattants et la distribution du courrier se poursuivent sans interruption.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: Cependant, les CR gèlent généralement les dépenses aux niveaux de l'année précédente et peuvent limiter la capacité des agences à lancer de nouveaux programmes ou initiatives, ce qui explique pourquoi les législateurs et les responsables des agences les considèrent souvent comme une solution temporaire imparfaite plutôt que comme un substitut à la budgétisation régulière.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: Les marchés et les entrepreneurs fédéraux ont également tendance à surveiller de près ces échéances, car même de courts shutdowns peuvent perturber les paiements, retarder l'attribution des contrats et créer de l'incertitude pour les entreprises qui dépendent des cycles de financement fédéraux.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## La voie à suivre

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: La menace immédiate de shutdown étant écartée, l'attention se tourne maintenant vers ce qui se passera après les élections de mi-mandat.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: Les analystes notent que les sessions « lame duck » du Congrès — la période après une élection mais avant que les nouveaux membres élus ne prêtent serment — ont historiquement été utilisées pour traiter des dossiers législatifs majeurs et inachevés, y compris de grands paquets de dépenses.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: Le fait que cette date limite de décembre aboutisse à un ensemble complet de projets de loi de finances, à une autre prolongation à court terme ou à une nouvelle impasse dépendra probablement du résultat des élections de mi-mandat et de la façon dont l'équilibre des pouvoirs au Congrès évoluera en conséquence.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, l'accord bipartisan représente une trêve temporaire dans les batailles budgétaires récurrentes de Washington — une trêve qui maintient le gouvernement ouvert tout en laissant les questions les plus difficiles aux législateurs pour qu'ils les règlent plus tard cette année.

pt.title: Financiado até 11 de dezembro: Por dentro do acordo do Senado que empurrou uma disputa de paralisação para além das eleições de meio de mandato

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## Um Acordo de Última Hora Evita uma Paralisação em 1º de Outubro

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: Com o ano fiscal do governo federal prestes a terminar em 30 de setembro, líderes do Senado de ambos os partidos chegaram a um acordo bipartidário sobre uma resolução contínua (CR) que mantém as agências federais financiadas até **11 de dezembro**.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: O acordo foi aprovado na câmara com o apoio de membros de ambos os lados do espectro político, evitando por pouco uma interrupção no financiamento que teria forçado o fechamento de operações governamentais não essenciais justamente quando o novo ano fiscal começava.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: As resoluções contínuas são uma ferramenta rotineira, embora imperfeita, que o Congresso usa quando os legisladores não conseguem concluir o processo completo de dotações orçamentárias a tempo.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: Em vez de aprovar todas as doze leis de gastos anuais individualmente, uma CR estende os níveis atuais de financiamento por um período determinado, dando aos negociadores mais tempo para debater os detalhes de um orçamento de longo prazo sem interromper os serviços governamentais, os salários dos funcionários federais ou os pagamentos de benefícios dos quais milhões de americanos dependem.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## Por Que 11 de Dezembro Importa

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: A escolha de um prazo em dezembro é notável tanto pelo que evita quanto pelo que realiza.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: Ao definir o próximo limite de financiamento para depois do Dia das Eleições em novembro, o acordo efetivamente remove o financiamento do governo como um ponto de conflito ativo durante a reta final da temporada de campanhas de meio de mandato.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: Legisladores de ambos os lados têm historicamente receado lutas de paralisação de alto risco que coincidiam com as eleições, uma vez que as consequências políticas de uma paralisação podem ser imprevisíveis e tendem a afetar os ocupantes de cargos de ambos os partidos.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: Dito isso, empurrar o prazo para dezembro não resolve os desacordos subjacentes que tornaram difíceis de aprovar as dotações para o ano todo nos últimos anos.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: Disputas sobre o tamanho dos gastos discricionários, prioridades de financiamento para agências específicas e disposições políticas anexadas aos projetos de lei de gastos permanecem sem solução.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Líderes do Congresso de ambos os lados descreveram a extensão como uma forma de "comprar tempo" em vez de uma resolução, o que significa que uma negociação semelhante — potencialmente com maiores riscos — provavelmente ressurgirá nas semanas após as eleições de meio de mandato.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## O Que uma Resolução Contínua Faz e Não Faz

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: Para os cidadãos americanos comuns, uma CR geralmente significa que as operações do governo continuam praticamente como antes: os funcionários federais continuam trabalhando, as agências continuam funcionando e serviços como a Previdência Social, benefícios para veteranos e entrega de correspondência continuam sem interrupções.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: No entanto, as CRs normalmente congelam os gastos nos níveis do ano anterior e podem limitar a capacidade das agências de iniciar novos programas ou iniciativas, razão pela cual legisladores e autoridades de agências frequentemente as veem como um paliativo imperfeito em vez de um substituto para a elaboração regular do orçamento.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: Os mercados e os empreiteiros federais também tendem a monitorar esses prazos de perto, uma vez que mesmo paralisações curtas podem perturbar pagamentos, atrasar a concessão de contratos e criar incertezas para empresas que dependem dos ciclos de financiamento federal.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## O Caminho à Frente

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: Com a ameaça imediata de paralisação adiada, a atenção agora se volta para o que acontece após as eleições de meio de mandato.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: Analistas observam que as sessões de "pato coxo" do Congresso — o período após uma eleição, mas antes que os membros recém-eleitos tomem posse — têm sido historicamente usadas para lidar com importantes negócios legislativos inacabados, incluindo grandes pacotes de gastos.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: Se este prazo de dezembro resultará em um conjunto completo de projetos de lei de dotações, outra extensão de curto prazo ou um novo impasse provavelmente dependerá do resultado das eleições de meio de mandato e de como o equilíbrio de poder no Congresso mudará como resultado.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: Por ora, o acordo bipartidário representa uma trégua temporária nas recorrentes batalhas orçamentárias de Washington — uma que mantém o governo aberto, deixando as questões mais difíceis para os legisladores resolverem ainda este ano.

in.title: Didanai Hingga 11 Desember: Di Balik Kesepakatan Senat yang Mendorong Pertarungan Penutupan Pemerintah Melewati Pemilu Paruh Waktu

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## Kesepakatan Menit Terakhir Mencegah Penutupan Pemerintah pada 1 Oktober

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: Dengan tahun fiskal pemerintah federal yang akan berakhir pada 30 September, para pemimpin Senat dari kedua partai mencapai kesepakatan bipartisan mengenai resolusi berkelanjutan (CR) yang menjaga badan-badan federal tetap didanai hingga **11 Desember**.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: Kesepakatan tersebut lolos dari majelis dengan dukungan dari anggota kedua belah pihak, secara tipis menghindari jeda pendanaan yang akan memaksa penutupan operasi pemerintah yang tidak penting tepat saat tahun fiskal baru dimulai.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: Resolusi berkelanjutan adalah alat rutin, meskipun tidak sempurna, yang digunakan Kongres ketika para pembuat undang-undang tidak dapat menyelesaikan proses alokasi anggaran penuh tepat waktu.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: Alih-alih meloloskan kedua belas rancangan undang-undang pengeluaran tahunan secara terpisah, CR memperpanjang tingkat pendanaan saat ini untuk jangka waktu tertentu, memberikan negosiator lebih banyak waktu untuk membahas detail anggaran jangka panjang tanpa mengganggu layanan pemerintah, gaji pekerja federal, atau pembayaran tunjangan yang diandalkan oleh jutaan orang Amerika.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa 11 Desember Penting

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: Pilihan tenggat waktu Desember patut diperhatikan karena apa yang dihindarinya sama pentingnya dengan apa yang dicapainya.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: Dengan menetapkan batas waktu pendanaan berikutnya setelah Hari Pemilihan di bulan November, kesepakatan tersebut secara efektif menghapus pendanaan pemerintah sebagai titik api aktif selama masa akhir musim kampanye paruh waktu.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: Para pembuat undang-undang di kedua belah pihak secara historis waspada terhadap pertarungan penutupan pemerintah yang berisiko tinggi yang bertepatan dengan pemilihan umum, karena dampak politik dari penutupan pemerintah bisa tidak terduga dan cenderung memengaruhi petahana dari kedua partai.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: Meskipun demikian, mendorong tenggat waktu ke Desember tidak menyelesaikan ketidaksepakatan mendasar yang membuat alokasi anggaran setahun penuh sulit disahkan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: Perselisihan mengenai besarnya pengeluaran diskresioner, prioritas pendanaan untuk badan-badan tertentu, dan ketentuan kebijakan yang melekat pada rancangan undang-undang pengeluaran tetap belum terselesaikan.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Para pemimpin Kongres di kedua belah pihak telah menggambarkan perpanjangan ini sebagai cara untuk "membeli waktu" alih-alih sebuah resolusi, yang berarti negosiasi serupa — berpotensi dengan risiko yang lebih tinggi — kemungkinan akan muncul kembali dalam beberapa minggu setelah pemilihan paruh waktu.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dilakukan dan Tidak Dilakukan oleh Resolusi Berkelanjutan

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: Bagi warga Amerika sehari-hari, CR umumnya berarti operasi pemerintah berlanjut sebagian besar seperti sebelumnya: pegawai federal terus bekerja, badan-badan terus berjalan, dan layanan seperti Jaminan Sosial, tunjangan veteran, dan pengiriman surat terus berlanjut tanpa gangguan.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: Namun, CR biasanya membekukan pengeluaran pada tingkat tahun sebelumnya dan dapat membatasi kemampuan badan-badan untuk memulai program atau inisiatif baru, itulah sebabnya para pembuat undang-undang dan pejabat badan sering memandangnya sebagai solusi sementara yang tidak sempurna alih-alih pengganti penganggaran reguler.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: Pasar dan kontraktor federal juga cenderung mengawasi tenggat waktu ini dengan cermat, karena penutupan singkat pun dapat mengganggu pembayaran, menunda pemberian kontrak, dan menciptakan ketidakpastian bagi bisnis yang bergantung pada siklus pendanaan federal.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## Jalan ke Depan

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: Dengan ancaman penutupan pemerintah yang segera ditunda, perhatian sekarang beralih ke apa yang terjadi setelah pemilihan paruh waktu.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa sesi "lame duck" Kongres — periode setelah pemilihan tetapi sebelum anggota yang baru terpilih dilantik — secara historis telah digunakan untuk menangani urusan legislatif utama yang belum selesai, termasuk paket pengeluaran besar.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: Apakah tenggat waktu Desember ini menghasilkan serangkaian rancangan undang-undang alokasi anggaran penuh, perpanjangan jangka pendek lainnya, atau kebuntuan baru kemungkinan besar akan bergantung pada hasil pemilihan paruh waktu dan bagaimana keseimbangan kekuatan di Kongres bergeser sebagai akibatnya.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, kesepakatan bipartisan tersebut mewakili gencatan senjata sementara dalam pertempuran anggaran Washington yang berulang — gencatan senjata yang menjaga pemerintah tetap terbuka sambil membiarkan pertanyaan yang lebih sulit untuk diselesaikan oleh para pembuat undang-undang di akhir tahun ini.

ja.title: 12月11日まで予算措置を延長：中間選挙の先送りを決めた上院の舞台裏

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## 土壇場の合意により10月1日の閉鎖を回避

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: 連邦政府の会計年度が9月30日に終了する予定である中、両党の上院指導部は、連邦機関の資金提供を**12月11日**まで維持する継続予算決議（CR）について超党派の合意に達した。

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: この妥協案は両党の議員の支持を得て上院を通過し、新しい会計年度が始まると同時に非中核的な政府業務の閉鎖を余儀なくさせるはずだった資金の途絶を辛うじて回避した。

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: 継続予算決議は、議員が期限内に全予算案のプロセスを完了できない場合に議会が使用する、不完全ながらも定常的なツールである。

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: 12の年間支出法案を個別に可決するのではなく、CRは現在の資金水準を一定期間延長し、政府のサービス、連邦職員の給与、何百万人ものアメリカ人が依存している給付金を中断させることなく、交渉担当者が長期予算の詳細を詰めるためのより多くの時間を与える。

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## 12月11日が重要である理由

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: 12月の期限の選択は、それが何を達成するかと同じくらい、何を回避しているかという点で注目に値する。

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: 次の予算の崖を11月の選挙日以降に設定することで、この合意は中間選挙運動の終盤において、政府資金の提供を活発な火種から効果的に排除している。

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: 閉鎖による政治的影響は予測不可能であり、両党の現職者に影響を与える傾向があるため、両党の議員はこれまで、選挙と重なるハイリスクな閉鎖闘争に警戒心を抱いてきた。

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: とはいえ、期限を12月に延期しても、近年通年予算案の可決を困難にしてきた根本的な意見の不一致が解決されるわけではない。

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: 裁量支出の規模、特定の機関の資金配分の優先順位、支出法案に付随する政策規定を巡る争いは未解決のままである。

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: 両党の議会指導者は、この延長は解決策というよりも「時間を稼ぐ」ための手段であると表現しており、中間選挙の数週間後には、おそらくより高いリスクを伴って、同様の交渉が再び浮上する可能性が高いことを意味している。

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## 継続予算決議がすること、しないこと

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: 一般のアメリカ人にとって、CRは一般的に政府の業務がこれまで通り継続することを意味する。連邦職員は働き続け、機関は運営を続け、社会保障、退役軍人恩給、郵便配達などのサービスは中断されることなく継続する。

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: しかし、CRは通常、支出を前年度の水準に凍結し、新しいプログラムやイニシアチブを開始する機関の能力を制限する可能性があるため、議員や機関の当局者は、通常の予算編成の代わりではなく、不完全な一時しのぎと見なすことが多い。

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: 市場や連邦政府の請負業者もまた、短い閉鎖であっても支払いを混乱させ、契約の授与を遅らせ、連邦政府の資金調達サイクルに依存している企業に不確実性をもたらす可能性があるため、これらの期限を注意深く監視する傾向がある。

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: 差し迫った閉鎖の脅威が延期されたことで、関心は中間選挙後にどうなるかに移行する。

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: アナリストらは、議会の「レームダック」セッション（選挙後から新議員が就任するまでの期間）は歴史的に、大規模な支出パッケージを含む、未解決の主要な立法課題に取り組むために利用されてきたと指摘している。

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: この12月の期限が予算案の完全なセット、別の短期延長、あるいは新たなこう着状態のいずれをもたらすかは、中間選挙の結果と、その結果として議会の権力のバランスがどのようにシフトするかに依存する可能性が高い。

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: 当面の間、この超党派の合意はワシントンの繰り返される予算闘争における一時的な休戦を表しており、政府を開いたままにする一方で、より困難な問題は今年後半に議員たちが解決するために残されている。

de.title: Finanzierung bis zum 11. Dezember: Einblicke in das Senatsabkommen, das einen Shutdown-Streit über die Zwischenwahlen hinaus verschob

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## Eine Last-Minute-Einigung verhindert einen Shutdown zum 1. Oktober

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: Da das Haushaltsjahr der Bundesregierung am 30. September enden sollte, erzielten die Senatsführer beider Parteien eine parteiübergreifende Einigung auf eine Übergangsfinanzierung (Continuing Resolution, CR), die die Finanzierung der Bundesbehörden bis zum **11. Dezember** sichert.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: Das Abkommen passierte die Kammer mit Unterstützung von Mitgliedern beider Parteien und verhinderte knapp eine Finanzierungslücke, die genau zu Beginn des neuen Haushaltsjahres einen Shutdown der nicht-essentiellen Regierungsgeschäfte erzwungen hätte.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: Übergangsfinanzierungen sind ein routinemäßiges, wenn auch unvollkommenes Instrument, das der Kongress nutzt, wenn die Gesetzgeber den vollständigen Bewilligungsprozess nicht rechtzeitig abschließen können.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: Anstatt alle zwölf jährlichen Ausgabengesetze einzeln zu verabschieden, verlängert eine CR das aktuelle Finanzierungsniveau für einen festgelegten Zeitraum. Dies gibt den Verhandlungsführern mehr Zeit, die Details eines längerfristigen Haushalts auszuarbeiten, ohne Regierungsdienste, Gehaltszahlungen für Bundesangestellte oder Sozialleistungen, auf die Millionen Amerikaner angewiesen sind, zu unterbrechen.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum der 11. Dezember wichtig ist

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: Die Wahl des Dezember-Termins ist sowohl wegen dessen, was er vermeidet, als auch wegen dessen, was er erreicht, bemerkenswert.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: Indem die nächste Finanzierungsklippe auf die Zeit nach dem Wahltag im November gelegt wurde, entzieht das Abkommen die Regierungsfinanzierung effektiv als aktiven Streitpunkt während der letzten Phase des Zwischenwahlkampfs.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: Gesetzgeber beider Seiten waren historisch gesehen vorsichtig bei Shutdown-Kämpfen mit hohem Einsatz, die mit Wahlen zusammenfallen, da die politischen Folgen eines Shutdowns unvorhersehbar sein können und dazu neigen, Amtsinhaber beider Parteien zu treffen.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: Dennoch löst die Verschiebung der Frist auf Dezember nicht die zugrunde liegenden Meinungsverschiedenheiten, die es in den letzten Jahren schwierig gemacht haben, ganzjährige Bewilligungen zu verabschieden.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: Streitigkeiten über den Umfang der diskretionären Ausgaben, Finanzierungsprioritäten für bestimmte Behörden und politische Bestimmungen, die an Ausgabengesetze geknüpft sind, bleiben ungelöst.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Die Kongressführer beider Seiten haben die Verlängerung als eine Möglichkeit beschrieben, "Zeit zu gewinnen", anstatt als eine Lösung, was bedeutet, dass eine ähnliche Verhandlung – möglicherweise mit höherem Einsatz – wahrscheinlich in den Wochen nach den Zwischenwahlen wieder aufkommen wird.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## Was eine Übergangsfinanzierung bewirkt und was nicht

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: Für die normalen Amerikaner bedeutet eine CR im Allgemeinen, dass der Regierungsbetrieb weitgehend wie bisher weiterläuft: Bundesangestellte arbeiten weiter, Behörden bleiben in Betrieb und Dienste wie Sozialversicherung, Leistungen für Veteranen und die Postzustellung werden nicht unterbrochen.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: Allerdings frieren CRs die Ausgaben in der Regel auf dem Niveau des Vorjahres ein und können die Fähigkeit der Behörden einschränken, neue Programme oder Initiativen zu starten, weshalb Gesetzgeber und Behördenvertreter sie oft als unvollkommene Notlösung und nicht als Ersatz für eine reguläre Haushaltsplanung betrachten.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: Märkte und Bundesauftragnehmer beobachten diese Fristen ebenfalls genau, da selbst kurze Shutdowns Zahlungen stören, die Vergabe von Aufträgen verzögern und Unsicherheit für Unternehmen schaffen können, die auf staatliche Finanzierungszyklen angewiesen sind.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## Der Weg nach vorn

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: Da die unmittelbare Shutdown-Drohung verschoben wurde, richtet sich die Aufmerksamkeit nun darauf, was nach den Zwischenwahlen passiert.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: Analysten merken an, dass "Lame Duck"-Sitzungen des Kongresses – der Zeitraum nach einer Wahl, aber bevor die neu gewählten Mitglieder vereidigt werden – historisch dazu genutzt wurden, wichtige, unerledigte gesetzgeberische Aufgaben anzugehen, einschließlich großer Ausgabenpakete.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: Ob diese Dezember-Frist zu einem vollständigen Satz von Bewilligungsgesetzen, einer weiteren kurzfristigen Verlängerung oder einer erneuten Pattsituation führt, wird wahrscheinlich vom Ausgang der Zwischenwahlen und davon abhängen, wie sich das Machtgleichgewicht im Kongress dadurch verschiebt.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: Für den Moment stellt die parteiübergreifende Einigung einen vorübergehenden Waffenstillstand in den wiederkehrenden Haushaltskämpfen Washingtons dar – einen, der die Regierung offen hält, während die schwierigeren Fragen den Gesetzgebern für später in diesem Jahr überlassen bleiben.

vi.title: Được cấp ngân sách đến ngày 11 tháng 12: Bên trong thỏa thuận của Thượng viện giúp đẩy lùi cuộc chiến đóng cửa chính phủ qua kỳ bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ

segments.src: ## A Last-Minute Deal Averts a October 1 Shutdown
segments.tr: ## Thỏa thuận phút chót giúp tránh nguy cơ đóng cửa chính phủ vào ngày 1 tháng 10

segments.src: With the federal government's fiscal year set to end on September 30, Senate leaders from both parties reached a bipartisan agreement on a continuing resolution (CR) that keeps federal agencies funded through **December 11**.
segments.tr: Khi năm tài chính của chính phủ liên bang chuẩn bị kết thúc vào ngày 30 tháng 9, các nhà lãnh đạo Thượng viện từ cả hai đảng đã đạt được một thỏa thuận lưỡng đảng về một nghị quyết tiếp tục ngân sách (CR) giúp duy trì nguồn vốn cho các cơ quan liên bang đến ngày **11 tháng 12**.

segments.src: The deal cleared the chamber with support from members on both sides of the aisle, narrowly avoiding a lapse in funding that would have forced a shutdown of non-essential government operations just as the new fiscal year began.
segments.tr: Thỏa thuận đã được thông qua tại Thượng viện với sự ủng hộ từ các thành viên của cả hai bên chiến tuyến, suýt soát tránh được tình trạng gián đoạn ngân sách vốn có thể buộc các hoạt động không thiết yếu của chính phủ phải đóng cửa ngay khi năm tài chính mới bắt đầu.

segments.src: Continuing resolutions are a routine, if imperfect, tool Congress uses when lawmakers cannot finish the full appropriations process on time.
segments.tr: Các nghị quyết tiếp tục ngân sách là một công cụ thường lệ, dù chưa hoàn hảo, mà Quốc hội sử dụng khi các nhà lập pháp không thể hoàn thành toàn bộ quy trình phân bổ ngân sách đúng hạn.

segments.src: Rather than passing all twelve annual spending bills individually, a CR extends current funding levels for a set period, giving negotiators more time to hash out the details of a longer-term budget without interrupting government services, paychecks for federal workers, or benefit payments that millions of Americans rely on.
segments.tr: Thay vì thông qua riêng rẽ tất cả mười hai dự luật chi tiêu hàng năm, một CR sẽ gia hạn mức ngân sách hiện tại trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định, giúp các nhà đàm phán có thêm thời gian để thảo luận chi tiết về một ngân sách dài hạn hơn mà không làm gián đoạn các dịch vụ của chính phủ, tiền lương của nhân viên liên bang hoặc các khoản thanh toán phúc lợi mà hàng triệu người Mỹ đang phụ thuộc vào.

segments.src: ## Why December 11 Matters
segments.tr: ## Tại sao ngày 11 tháng 12 lại quan trọng

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline is notable for what it avoids as much as what it accomplishes.
segments.tr: Việc lựa chọn thời hạn chót vào tháng 12 là đáng chú ý vì những gì nó tránh được cũng nhiều như những gì nó đạt được.

segments.src: By setting the next funding cliff for after Election Day in November, the agreement effectively removes government funding as an active flashpoint during the final stretch of the midterm campaign season.
segments.tr: Bằng cách đặt ra ranh giới ngân sách tiếp theo sau Ngày Bầu cử vào tháng 11, thỏa thuận này đã loại bỏ một cách hiệu quả vấn đề ngân sách chính phủ khỏi việc trở thành một điểm nóng tranh chấp trong giai đoạn nước rút cuối cùng của mùa chiến dịch bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: Lawmakers on both sides have historically been wary of high-stakes shutdown fights coinciding with elections, since the political fallout from a shutdown can be unpredictable and tends to affect incumbents of both parties.
segments.tr: Các nhà lập pháp của cả hai bên trong lịch sử luôn cảnh giác với các cuộc chiến đóng cửa chính phủ đầy rủi ro trùng với thời điểm bầu cử, vì những hệ lụy chính trị từ việc đóng cửa chính phủ có thể rất khó lường và có xu hướng ảnh hưởng đến các nghị sĩ đương nhiệm của cả hai đảng.

segments.src: That said, pushing the deadline to December doesn't resolve the underlying disagreements that have made full-year appropriations difficult to pass in recent years.
segments.tr: Dù vậy, việc đẩy thời hạn chót sang tháng 12 không giải quyết được những bất đồng cốt lõi vốn đã khiến các dự luật phân bổ ngân sách cả năm khó được thông qua trong những năm gần đây.

segments.src: Disputes over the size of discretionary spending, funding priorities for specific agencies, and policy provisions attached to spending bills remain unsettled.
segments.tr: Các tranh chấp về quy mô chi tiêu tùy ý, các ưu tiên ngân sách cho các cơ quan cụ thể và các điều khoản chính sách đi kèm với các dự luật chi tiêu vẫn chưa được giải quyết.

segments.src: Congressional leaders on both sides have described the extension as a way to "buy time" rather than a resolution, meaning a similar negotiation — potentially with higher stakes — is likely to resurface in the weeks after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Các nhà lãnh đạo Quốc hội của cả hai bên đã mô tả việc gia hạn này là một cách để "mua thêm thời gian" chứ không phải là một giải pháp triệt để, nghĩa là một cuộc đàm phán tương tự — có khả năng với rủi ro cao hơn — có thể sẽ tái diễn trong những tuần sau cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Does and Doesn't Do
segments.tr: ## Một nghị quyết tiếp tục ngân sách làm được và không làm được gì

segments.src: For everyday Americans, a CR generally means government operations continue largely as before: federal employees keep working, agencies keep running, and services like Social Security, veterans' benefits, and mail delivery continue uninterrupted.
segments.tr: Đối với người dân Mỹ bình thường, một CR nhìn chung có nghĩa là các hoạt động của chính phủ vẫn tiếp tục phần lớn như trước: nhân viên liên bang tiếp tục làm việc, các cơ quan tiếp tục vận hành, và các dịch vụ như An sinh Xã hội, phúc lợi cho cựu chiến binh và chuyển phát thư từ vẫn tiếp tục không bị gián đoạn.

segments.src: However, CRs typically freeze spending at prior-year levels and can limit agencies' ability to start new programs or initiatives, which is why lawmakers and agency officials often view them as an imperfect stopgap rather than a substitute for regular budgeting.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, các CR thường đóng băng chi tiêu ở mức của năm trước và có thể hạn chế khả năng của các cơ quan trong việc khởi động các chương trình hoặc sáng kiến mới, đó là lý do tại sao các nhà lập pháp và các quan chức cơ quan thường coi chúng là một biện pháp tạm thời chưa hoàn hảo hơn là một sự thay thế cho việc lập ngân sách thông thường.

segments.src: Markets and federal contractors also tend to watch these deadlines closely, since even short shutdowns can disrupt payments, delay contract awards, and create uncertainty for businesses that rely on federal funding cycles.
segments.tr: Thị trường và các nhà thầu liên bang cũng có xu hướng theo dõi chặt chẽ các thời hạn này, vì ngay cả những đợt đóng cửa ngắn hạn cũng có thể làm gián đoạn các khoản thanh toán, trì hoãn việc trao thầu và tạo ra sự bất ổn cho các doanh nghiệp phụ thuộc vào chu kỳ ngân sách liên bang.

segments.src: ## The Road Ahead
segments.tr: ## Con đường phía trước

segments.src: With the immediate shutdown threat postponed, attention now shifts to what happens after the midterms.
segments.tr: Với mối đe dọa đóng cửa chính phủ trước mắt đã được hoãn lại, sự chú ý giờ đây chuyển sang những gì xảy ra sau cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: Analysts note that "lame duck" sessions of Congress — the period after an election but before newly elected members are sworn in — have historically been used to tackle major, unfinished legislative business, including large spending packages.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích lưu ý rằng các phiên họp "vịt què" của Quốc hội — khoảng thời gian sau cuộc bầu cử nhưng trước khi các thành viên mới đắc cử tuyên thệ nhậm chức — trong lịch sử đã được sử dụng để giải quyết các công việc lập pháp lớn còn dang dở, bao gồm cả các gói chi tiêu lớn.

segments.src: Whether this December deadline results in a full set of appropriations bills, another short-term extension, or a renewed standoff will likely depend on the outcome of the midterm elections and how the balance of power in Congress shifts as a result.
segments.tr: Liệu thời hạn chót vào tháng 12 này có dẫn đến một bộ dự luật phân bổ ngân sách đầy đủ, một đợt gia hạn ngắn hạn khác hay một cuộc bế tắc mới hay không có thể sẽ phụ thuộc vào kết quả của cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ và cán cân quyền lực tại Quốc hội sẽ thay đổi như thế nào sau đó.

segments.src: For now, the bipartisan agreement represents a temporary truce in Washington's recurring budget battles — one that keeps the government open while leaving the harder questions for lawmakers to settle later this year.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, thỏa thuận lưỡng đảng này thể hiện một lệnh đình chiến tạm thời trong các cuộc chiến ngân sách định kỳ của Washington — một thỏa thuận giúp chính phủ tiếp tục mở cửa trong khi để lại những câu hỏi khó hơn cho các nhà lập pháp giải quyết vào cuối năm nay.
